minutes.headline: Board recommended marijuana bylaw and, 3-1, six prohibition articles; approved a 400 Electric Ave gas station with conditions.
minutes.summary: The board approved an ANR plan for Sunset Lane, approved a solar special permit with added screening conditions, and recommended the marijuana zoning bylaw and the prohibition articles to Town Meeting after a long hearing. It then approved the drive-through special permit and site plan for 400 Electric Avenue with conditions on a shutoff valve and catch basin cleaning. The MRPC director spoke about past block grant problems, and the rest of the agenda was tabled to March 25.

what_happened.line: The board voted 3-1 to recommend six marijuana prohibition bylaws to Town Meeting, after also recommending the marijuana zoning bylaw as edited.
The board recommended the marijuana zoning bylaw as edited, after closing the public hearing.
The board approved the drive-through special permit for the 400 Electric Avenue gas station, then approved the site plan with an actuated valve and semi-annual catch basin cleaning.
The board approved the 190 Electric Ave solar project with added screening conditions: three evergreen species and a two-growing-season guarantee.
The board approved an ANR plan for Sunset Lane, and carried the rest of the agenda to March 25.

why_it_matters: The marijuana bylaw and the prohibition articles are items residents will be asked to vote on at Town Meeting, and the board's recommendations are what those votes will be weighed against.
The gas station approval carries drainage and spill conditions that bear on stormwater and wetland protection near the 400 Electric Avenue site.
watch_next: March 25: the board takes up the agenda items carried over from this meeting.
Town Meeting: votes on the marijuana bylaw and the six prohibition articles.
